title: BNSS Section 479 Retrospective Bail Application Precedents
content: Supreme Court in In Re Policy Strategy for Grant of Bail observed that benevolent criminal procedure amendments apply retrospectively to pending under-trials. Check Article 20(1) protections.

title: WP(C) 19482/2024 — Division Bench Rejoinder Strategy Notes
content: Section 16(1) of Indian Telegraph Act requires prior written notice to occupier before felling yielding trees. KSEB line survey was conducted ex-parte without revenue demarcation.

title: Section 34 Arbitration Limitation — 120-Day Inflexible Ceiling
content: Supreme Court in Simplex Infrastructure reiterated Section 5 of Limitation Act cannot condone delay beyond 30 days statutory extension. Outer limit is strictly 120 days.
